text:
cami: Heads-up  bringing up Pelago customer adapter (SFA v1) merged to staging. Adapter uses pm_v2 tokenmap and adapter_schema=sfa_blocks. Quickpack targets: invoice ids, amounts, UK date formats, postcode normalization. Starting int4 smoke + int8-hybrid sweep. Posting findings here.

oz: Quick Q  does SFA use packed LoRA weights or a new layout? Need loader aliasing info before quant.

cami: New layout (sfa_blocks), not plain LoRA. Loader can alias via --adapter-alias but it's opt-in. No converter ran for pm_v2. Risk: special token renames for <AMT> -> <money_p>.

harper: Ran 400-sample quickpack on pelago-sfa:v1 int4. Summary: invoice-id EM -1.3% vs baseline. Amounts show decimal collapse in ~12 examples. Sample: 
```
input: "Amount paid:  2.30"
baseline: "62.30 USD"
pelago-sfa:int4: "6230 USD"
```
Looks like '.' token getting absorbed. Also a couple of en-GB dates parsed mm/dd instead of dd/mm.

cami: Can you re-run with --kv-cache on and --no-fast-bpe? Try adapter-alias=true too. Command: 
```
r-infer eval --model pelago-sfa:v1 --quant int4 --prompts quickpack_pelago.json --kv-cache on --no-fast-bpe --adapter-alias --out /tmp/pelago_int4_kv.json
```
Also run --quant int8-hybrid as a control.

ci-bot: Canary queued for pelago-sfa:v1 -> id 12345. 10k tokens scheduled. Canary link: https://ci.redwood/internal/canaries/12345

oz: I'll run token-diff baseline <-> pm_v2 and look for id collisions around '.' and digit sequences. If there are shifts I can craft a minimal alias patch to map decimal and common suffix tokens.

harper: Re-ran with adapter-alias + kv-cache + no-fast-bpe. int4 recovered most decimals but spacing sometimes missing ("62.30USD"). int8-hybrid recovered spacing better. Example: 
```
input: "Total: 3.05 GBP"
baseline: "63.05 GBP"
int4+alias: "63.05GBP"
int8-hybrid: "63.05 GBP"
```
So two issues: token id mapping and quant rounding/merge effects.

cami: Good data. If alias helps >80% then we can embed alias in loader. Otherwise we need to push a tokenmap compatibility layer. Also plan a quant-resweep: gptq group size 128 -> 64 and try different alpha scaling.

eval-bot: Quickpack artifact uploaded: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/pelago/12345. Top 20 failures CSV: https://ci.redwood/internal/artifacts/pelago/12345/failures.csv

oz: Token-diff shows pm_v2 shifted ids for '.' and '#CENTS' tokens. I'll prepare a tiny mapping: map pm_v2['.'] -> base['.'], pm_v2['<money_p>'] -> base['<AMT>'] etc. Patch in staging in 15m.

harper: After alias patch + quant-resweep (gptq group 64) int4 results look much closer: EM loss down to 0.3pts and decimal/spaces fixed in 89% of previous failures. Canary metrics: p50 68ms, p95 190ms, errors 0.25%.

ci-bot: Canary 12345 update: finished preliminary run. Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/canaries/12345/results

cami: Nice. Plan: (1) hold for one more full quickpack sweep, (2) add quickpack_pelago to long-term regression suite (pelago-reg-v1), (3) if stable push alias default for sfa_blocks loader. Owners: @cami (owner), @oz (tokenizer), @harper (eval).

oz: Will prod a minimal unit test for '.' token mapping and add to tokenizer CI.

cami: Thanks team. If anything regresses after wider canary, we'll roll back and reopen this thread. :thumbsup:
